shloka_text: तां कथामिलसम्बद्धां रामेण समुदीरिताम् । लक्ष्मणो भरतश्चैव श्रुत्वा परमविस्मितौ ।। 7.88.1 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ kathāmilasambaddhāṃ rāmeṇa samudīritām | lakṣmaṇo bharataścaiva śrutvā paramavismitau || 7.88.1 ||
translation: ताम् that, कथाम् story, इलसम्बद्धाम् related to Ila, रामेण by Rama, समुदीरिताम् narrated, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतः Bharata, च and, एव indeed, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमविस्मितौ greatly astonished.
explanation: Having heard that story related to Ila, narrated by Rama, Lakshmana and Bharata were greatly astonished.
comments: Asked how Ila fared, Rama continues: as a woman she wanders the forest and comes upon Budha, son of Soma, at his penance -- smitten, Budha learns by his spell who she is, and turns her companions, the former men, into Kimpurushis to dwell on the mountain with Kimpurusha husbands.

shloka_text: तौ रामं प्राञ्जली भूत्वा तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः । विस्तरं तस्य भावस्य तदा पप्रच्छतुः पुनः ।। 7.88.2 ।।
transliteration: tau rāmaṃ prāñjalī bhūtvā tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ | vistaraṃ tasya bhāvasya tadā papracchatuḥ punaḥ || 7.88.2 ||
translation: तौ they (the two), रामं to Rama, प्राञ्जली with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, महात्मनः great-souled, विस्तरं the details, तस्य of that, भावस्य state/condition, तदा then, पप्रच्छतुः asked, पुनः again.
explanation: The two, with folded hands, then again asked Rama for the detailed account of the great-souled king's condition.

shloka_text: कथं स राजा स्त्रीभूतो वर्तयामास दुर्गतिः । पुरुषः स यदा भूतः कां वृत्तिं वर्तयत्यसौ ।। 7.88.3 ।।
transliteration: kathaṃ sa rājā strībhūto vartayāmāsa durgatiḥ | puruṣaḥ sa yadā bhūtaḥ kāṃ vṛttiṃ vartayatyasau || 7.88.3 ||
translation: कथं how, स that, राजा king, स्त्रीभूतो having become a woman, वर्तयामास lived, दुर्गतिः in misfortune, पुरुषः a man, स he, यदा when, भूतः became, कां what, वृत्तिं way of life, वर्तयत्यसौ did he lead.
explanation: They inquired how that king lived in misfortune after becoming a woman, and what kind of life he led when he became a man again.

shloka_text: तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् । कथयामास काकुत्स्थस्तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् ।। 7.88.4 ।।
transliteration: tayostadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam | kathayāmāsa kākutsthastasya rājño yathāgatam || 7.88.4 ||
translation: तयोः of those two, तद्भाषितं their speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, कथयामास narrated, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, यथागतम् as it happened.
explanation: Hearing their speech, which was full of curiosity, Rama (Kakutstha) narrated the king's story exactly as it had happened.

shloka_text: तमेव प्रथमं मासं स्त्रीभूता लोकसुन्दरी । ताभिः परिवृता स्त्रीभिर्ये च पूर्वपदानुगाः ।। 7.88.5 ।।
transliteration: tameva prathamaṃ māsaṃ strībhūtā lokasundarī | tābhiḥ parivṛtā strībhirye ca pūrvapadānugāḥ || 7.88.5 ||
translation: तं that, एव very, प्रथमं first, मासं month, स्त्रीभूता having become a woman, लोकसुन्दरी beautiful in the world, ताभिः by those, परिवृता surrounded, स्त्रीभिः by women, ये who, च and, पूर्वपदानुगाः followed his former position.
explanation: For that very first month, having become a woman of unparalleled beauty, she was surrounded by the women who had previously been part of his retinue.

shloka_text: तत्काननं विगाह्वाशु विजह्रे लोकसुन्दरी । द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं पद्भ्यां पद्मदलेक्षणा ।। 7.88.6 ।।
transliteration: tatkānanaṃ vigāhvāśu vijahre lokasundarī | drumagulmalatākīrṇaṃ padbhyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇā || 7.88.6 ||
translation: तत्काननं that forest, विगाह्वा having entered, आशु quickly, विजह्रे roamed, लोकसुन्दरी the beautiful woman, द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, पद्भ्यां with her feet, पद्मदलेक्षणा lotus-petal-eyed.
explanation: The lotus-petal-eyed woman, beautiful in the world, quickly entered that forest, which was filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, and roamed through it on foot.

shloka_text: वाहनानि च सर्वाणि सा त्यक्त्वा वै समन्ततः । पर्वताभोगविवरे तस्मिन्रेमे इला तदा ।। 7.88.7 ।।
transliteration: vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi sā tyaktvā vai samantataḥ | parvatābhogavivare tasminreme ilā tadā || 7.88.7 ||
translation: वाहनानि conveyances, च and, सर्वाणि all, सा she, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, वै indeed, समन्ततः all around, पर्वताभोगविवरे in the wide expanse of the mountain, तस्मिन् in that, रेमे she delighted, इला Ilā, तदा then.
explanation: Then, Ilā, having completely abandoned all her conveyances, delighted in that wide mountain cavity.

shloka_text: अथ तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे पर्वतस्याविदूरतः । सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यं नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् ।। 7.88.8 ।।
transliteration: atha tasminvanoddeśe parvatasyāvidūrataḥ | saraḥ suruciraprakhyaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairyutam || 7.88.8 ||
translation: अथ then, तस्मिन् in that, वनोद्देशे forest region, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, अविदूरतः not far from, सरः a lake, सुरुचिरप्रख्यं very beautiful in appearance, नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् endowed with various flocks of birds.
explanation: Then, in that forest region not far from the mountain, there was a lake, very beautiful in appearance and filled with various flocks of birds.

shloka_text: ददर्श सा त्विला तस्मिन्बुधं सोमसुतं तदा । ज्वलन्तं स्वेन वपुषा पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् ।। 7.88.9 ।।
transliteration: dadarśa sā tvilā tasminbudhaṃ somasutaṃ tadā | jvalantaṃ svena vapuṣā pūrṇasomamivoditam || 7.88.9 ||
translation: ददर्श she saw, सा she, तु indeed, इला Ilā, तस्मिन् in that, बुधं Budha, सोमसुतं son of Soma, तदा then, ज्वलन्तं shining, स्वेन with his own, वपुषा body, पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् like the full moon risen.
explanation: Then, Ilā saw Budha, the son of Soma, in that place, shining with his own body like the risen full moon.

shloka_text: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम् । यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम् ।। 7.88.10 ।।
transliteration: tapantaṃ ca tapastīvramambhomadhye durāsadam | yaśaskaraṃ kāmakaraṃ kāruṇye paryavasthitam || 7.88.10 ||
translation: तपन्तं performing penance, च and, तपः penance, तीव्रम् intense, अम्भोमध्ये in the midst of water, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, यशस्करं bestowing fame, कामकरं fulfilling desires, कारुण्ये in compassion, पर्यवस्थितम् established.
explanation: He was performing intense and formidable penance in the midst of water, established in compassion, bestowing fame and fulfilling desires.

shloka_text: सा तं जलाशयं सर्वं क्षोभयामास विस्मिता । सहगैः पूर्वपुरुषैः स्त्रीभूतै रघुनन्दन ।। 7.88.11 ।।
transliteration: sā taṃ jalāśayaṃ sarvaṃ kṣobhayāmāsa vismitā | sahagaiḥ pūrvapuruṣaiḥ strībhūtai raghunandana || 7.88.11 ||
translation: सा she, तं that, जलाशयं body of water, सर्वं entire, क्षोभयामास she agitated, विस्मिता astonished, सहगैः with her companions, पूर्वपुरुषैः former men, स्त्रीभूतैः having become women, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, astonished, she agitated that entire body of water along with her companions, who were formerly men but had also become women.

shloka_text: बुधस्तु तां समीक्ष्यैव कामबाणवशं गतः । नोपलेभे तदा ऽ ऽत्मानं सञ्चचाल तदा ऽ ऽम्भसि ।। 7.88.12 ।।
transliteration: budhastu tāṃ samīkṣyaiva kāmabāṇavaśaṃ gataḥ | nopalebhe tadā ' 'tmānaṃ sañcacāla tadā ' 'mbhasi || 7.88.12 ||
translation: बुधः Budha, तु but, तां her, समीक्ष्यैव having just seen, कामबाणवशं the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen into, न not, उपलेभे perceived, तदा then, आत्मानं himself, सञ्चचाल moved, तदा then, अम्भसि in the water.
explanation: But Budha, having just seen her, fell under the sway of Cupid's arrows, lost control of himself, and then stirred in the water.

shloka_text: इलां निरीक्षमाणस्तु त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां शुभाम् । चिन्तां समभ्यतिक्रामत् का न्वियं देवताधिका ।। 7.88.13 ।।
transliteration: ilāṃ nirīkṣamāṇastu trailokyābhyadhikāṃ śubhām | cintāṃ samabhyatikrāmat kā nviyaṃ devatādhikā || 7.88.13 ||
translation: इलां Ila, निरीक्षमाणस्तु looking at, त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां superior to the three worlds, शुभाम् beautiful, चिन्तां a thought, समभ्यतिक्रामत् came to him, का who, नु indeed, इयं this, देवताधिका superior goddess.
explanation: As he gazed at Ila, who was more beautiful than anything in the three worlds, a thought came to him: "Who indeed is this superior goddess?"

shloka_text: न देवीषु न नागीषु नासुरीष्वप्सरःसु च । दृष्टपूर्वा मया काचिद्रूपेणानेन शोभिता ।। 7.88.14 ।।
transliteration: na devīṣu na nāgīṣu nāsurīṣvapsaraḥsu ca | dṛṣṭapūrvā mayā kācidrūpeṇānena śobhitā || 7.88.14 ||
translation: न not, देवीषु among goddesses, न not, नागीषु among Nāga women, न not, आसुरीषु among Asura women, अप्सरःसु among Apsaras, च and, दृष्टपूर्वा seen before, मया by me, काचित् any, रूपेण by form, अनेन by this, शोभिता adorned.
explanation: Never before have I seen anyone adorned with such beauty, neither among goddesses, Nāga women, Asura women, nor Apsaras.

shloka_text: सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहः । इति बुद्धिं समास्थाय जलात्कूलमुपागमत् ।। 7.88.15 ।।
transliteration: sadṛśīyaṃ mama bhavedyadi nānyaparigrahaḥ | iti buddhiṃ samāsthāya jalātkūlamupāgamat || 7.88.15 ||
translation: सदृशी suitable, इयं this (woman), मम for me, भवेत् would be, यदि if, न not, अन्यपरिग्रहः taken by another, इति thus, बुद्धिं a thought, समास्थाय having firmly resolved, जलात् from the water, कूलं to the bank, उपागमत् he went.
explanation: Having firmly resolved that she would be suitable for him if she were not already taken by another, he then went from the water to the bank.

shloka_text: आश्रमं समुपागम्य ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः । शब्दापयत धर्मात्मा ताश्चैनं च ववन्दिरे ।। 7.88.16 ।।
transliteration: āśramaṃ samupāgamya tatastāḥ pramadottamāḥ | śabdāpayata dharmātmā tāścainaṃ ca vavandire || 7.88.16 ||
translation: आश्रमं to the hermitage, समुपागम्य having approached, ततः then, ताः those, प्रमदोत्तमाः excellent women, शब्दापयत called out to, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, ताः they, च and, एनं him, च and, ववन्दिरे bowed down.
explanation: Having approached the hermitage, the righteous Budha then called out to those excellent women, and they, in turn, bowed down to him.

shloka_text: स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी । किमर्थमागता चैव सर्वमाख्यात मा चिरम् ।। 7.88.17 ।।
transliteration: sa tāḥ papraccha dharmātmā kasyaiṣā lokasundarī | kimarthamāgatā caiva sarvamākhyāta mā ciram || 7.88.17 ||
translation: सः He, ताः them, पप्रच्छ asked, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, कस्य whose, एषा is this, लोकसुन्दरी world-beautiful woman, किमर्थम् for what purpose, आगता has come, च and, एव indeed, सर्वम् everything, आख्यात tell, मा not, चिरम् delay
explanation: The righteous king asked them, "Whose is this most beautiful woman, and for what purpose has she come? Tell me everything without delay."

shloka_text: शुभं तु तस्य तद्वाक्यं मधुरं मधुराक्षरम् । श्रुत्वा स्त्रियश्च ताः सर्वा ऊचुर्मधुरया गिरा ।। 7.88.18 ।।
transliteration: śubhaṃ tu tasya tadvākyaṃ madhuraṃ madhurākṣaram | śrutvā striyaśca tāḥ sarvā ūcurmadhurayā girā || 7.88.18 ||
translation: शुभम् auspicious, तु indeed, तस्य his, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, मधुरम् sweet, मधुराक्षरम् with sweet words, श्रुत्वा having heard, स्त्रियः women, च and, ताः those, सर्वाः all, ऊचुः spoke, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice
explanation: Having heard his auspicious, sweet, and melodious words, all those women replied with a sweet voice.

shloka_text: अस्माकमेषा सुश्रोणी प्रभुत्वे वर्तते सदा । अपतिः काननान्तेषु सहास्माभिश्चरत्यसौ ।। 7.88.19 ।।
transliteration: asmākameṣā suśroṇī prabhutve vartate sadā | apatiḥ kānanānteṣu sahāsmābhiścaratyasau || 7.88.19 ||
translation: अस्माकम् our, एषा this, सुश्रोणी beautiful-hipped woman, प्रभुत्वे in authority, वर्तते is, सदा always, अपतिः without a husband, काननान्तेषु in the forest regions, सह with, अस्माभिः us, चरति wanders, असौ she
explanation: This beautiful-hipped woman is always in authority over us; she wanders in the forest regions without a husband, accompanied by us.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यमव्यक्तपदं तासां स्त्रीणां निशम्य च । विद्यामावर्तनीं पुण्यामावर्तयत स द्विजः ।। 7.88.20 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyamavyaktapadaṃ tāsāṃ strīṇāṃ niśamya ca | vidyāmāvartanīṃ puṇyāmāvartayata sa dvijaḥ || 7.88.20 ||
translation: तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, अव्यक्तपदम् with unclear words, तासाम् of those, स्त्रीणाम् women, निशम्य having heard, च and, विद्याम् knowledge/spell, आवर्तनीम् that which causes return, पुण्याम् sacred, आवर्तयत recited, सः that, द्विजः brahmin
explanation: Having heard that speech with indistinct words from those women, that brahmin recited the sacred spell that causes return.

shloka_text: सो ऽर्थं विदित्वा सकलं तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् । सर्वा एव स्त्रियस्ताश्च बभाषे मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.88.21 ।।
transliteration: so 'rthaṃ viditvā sakalaṃ tasya rājño yathāgatam | sarvā eva striyastāśca babhāṣe munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.88.21 ||
translation: सः He, अर्थम् the meaning, विदित्वा having known, सकलम् the entire, तस्य of that, राज्ञः king, यथागतम् as it happened, सर्वाः all, एव indeed, स्त्रियः women, ताः those, च and, बभाषे spoke, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages
explanation: Having understood the entire situation of that king as it had occurred, the foremost among sages then spoke to all those women.

shloka_text: अत्र किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा शैलरोधसि वत्स्यथ । आवासस्तु गिरावस्मिञ्छीघ्रमेव विधीयताम् ।। 7.88.22 ।।
transliteration: atra kimpuruṣīrbhūtvā śailarodhasi vatsyatha | āvāsastu girāvasmiñchīghrameva vidhīyatām || 7.88.22 ||
translation: अत्र here, किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा becoming Kimpurushis, शैलरोधसि on the mountain slope, वत्स्यथ you shall dwell, आवासस्तु but a dwelling place, गिरावस्मिन् on this mountain, शीघ्रमेव quickly indeed, विधीयताम् let it be arranged.
explanation: You shall dwell here on the mountain slope, becoming Kimpurushis, and a dwelling place on this mountain should be arranged quickly.

shloka_text: मूलपत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा । स्त्रियः किम्पुरुषान्नाम भर्तऽन्समुपलप्स्यथ ।। 7.88.23 ।।
transliteration: mūlapatraphalaiḥ sarvā vartayiṣyatha nityadā | striyaḥ kimpuruṣānnāma bharta'nsamupalapsyatha || 7.88.23 ||
translation: मूलपत्रफलैः with roots, leaves, and fruits, सर्वा all (of you), वर्तयिष्यथ you shall sustain yourselves, नित्यदा always, स्त्रियः women, किम्पुरुषान्नाम named Kimpurushas, भर्तऽन् husbands, समुपलप्स्यथ you shall obtain.
explanation: All of you shall always sustain yourselves with roots, leaves, and fruits, and as women, you shall obtain husbands named Kimpurushas.

shloka_text: ताः श्रुत्वा सोमपुत्रस्य वाचं किम्पुरुषीकृताः । उपासाञ्चक्रिरे शैलं वध्वस्ता बहुलास्तदा ।। 7.88.24 ।।
transliteration: tāḥ śrutvā somaputrasya vācaṃ kimpuruṣīkṛtāḥ | upāsāñcakrire śailaṃ vadhvastā bahulāstadā || 7.88.24 ||
translation: ताः those, श्रुत्वा having heard, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma, वाचं the word, किम्पुरुषीकृताः having been made Kimpurushis, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे they resided near, शैलं the mountain, वध्वस्ता those women, बहुलाः many, तदा then.
explanation: Then, those many women, having been transformed into Kimpurushis upon hearing the words of Budha, the son of Soma, resided near that mountain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 88 ।। Thus ends the eighty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
